rationale: The agent did not authenticate the user but also did not access or change any account or order data, so no authentication was required. They correctly stated that they could not reinstate a cancelled order per their stated system policy, offered the appropriate alternative (place a new order), and, when the user insisted, they handed off to a human agent—an appropriate action when a request falls outside what the system permits. No unauthorized writes were performed, no confirmation step was skipped (since no change was made), and the final user request—to be transferred—was completed successfully. The only minor concern is the absolute phrasing about policy without tool verification, but it does not contradict the provided policy summary and no fabricated order details were given. Overall, this meets the pass criteria.
